title: The Deadman #6
desc:
IT'S THE END OF THE BEGINNING FOR THIS NEXT LEVEL REIMAGINING OF BOSTON BRAND—THE DEADMAN.

Back in present day—and burdened with a terrible vision of a future without Heaven or Hell—the Custodian of Souls must rally the ghosts of Robertsville (with a little help from a nearby hospital) to fight an invisible war against Mr. M's Soul-Eaters.

But just who is Menirad Metzger? And who is the old man that taught M to stay young forever?

Questions compound and answers flicker into view like the bulb of a street lamp in this last first chapter of the Justice League's dark defender of the Afterlife. (And hey—Bobby's there, too!)
